title: Stunning footage of the treatment and release of a Caspian seal.
text:
Stunning footage of the treatment and release of a Caspian seal."

"According to Mehr News Agency, the seal was found about a month ago after becoming entangled in stray fishing nets. It had severe injuries, general weakness, weight loss and impaired vision."

" The animal was transferred to the Miankaleh Rescue and Rehabilitation Center, where it received veterinary care and nutritional support. During treatment, it gained about 10 kg and recovered to a suitable condition."

"With cooperation from the Mazandaran Provincial Departments of Environment and Ports and Maritime, the seal was released back into its natural habitat about 10 km off the coast of Bandar Amir Abad, at a depth of 30 meters in the Caspian Sea.
